STATEMENT OF SUPPORT on the Appointment of Secretary Vince Dizon as DPWH Secretary

The Quezon City Government warmly welcomes the appointment of Secretary Vince Dizon as the new head of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).

Secretary Dizon has consistently demonstrated exceptional leadership and dedication in every national responsibility entrusted to him—whether as former President and CEO of the Bases Conversion and Development Authority, as our country’s COVID-19 testing czar, or most recently as Secretary of Transportation. In each role, he has delivered transformative results that directly benefited our people and strengthened public trust in government institutions.

We are confident that under his stewardship, the DPWH will further embody transparency, accountability, and efficiency in the implementation of public infrastructure. In particular, we trust that Secretary Dizon will champion strategic, science-based, and community-driven solutions to the persistent problem of flooding, including the adoption and scaling of Quezon City’s Drainage Master Plan. These reforms are crucial in ensuring that every peso of public funds is maximized for infrastructure that safeguards lives, protects property, and builds resilience in the face of climate change.

We also extend our deepest appreciation to outgoing Secretary Manny Bonoan for his years of service and meaningful contributions to the Department.

The Quezon City Government conveys its full support and active cooperation with Secretary Dizon and the entire DPWH as we work together toward building safer, more inclusive, and future-ready infrastructure for all Filipinos.
